tldr: Venus in the 6th house: love becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With Venus in the 6th house, this part of you moves through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. Venus describes love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, and what makes connection feel worth choosing. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. Venus can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
